answer: Bill Gates and Paul Allen founded Microsoft. The two childhood friends from Seattle started it as a partnership on April 4, 1975, in Albuquerque, New Mexico [1][2]. They set up there to be near MITS, the company that made the Altair 8800 microcomputer, because they were writing a BASIC interpreter for that machine. Gates left Harvard to join Allen on the project [1][3]. Allen came up with the original name, "Micro-Soft." In 1979 the company moved to the Seattle area, where it is still based in Redmond, Washington [1][3].

sources.title: Bill Gates and Paul Allen founded Microsoft on this day, April 4, in 1975 - Windows Central
